PROCUREMENT POLICY
Policy Code: PRC-003
Title: Approved Suppliers and Conflicts of Interest
Version: 1.4
Effective Date: 2024-07-01
Category: suppliers
Company: Northwind Industrial Co.
1. Approved Supplier List
1.1 Purchases above USD 5,000 must be placed with a supplier on the approved supplier
    list.
1.2 A supplier may be added to the approved supplier list only after the procurement
    officer has reviewed its registration documents and tax identification.
2. Conflicts of Interest
2.1 Employees must disclose any personal or financial relationship with a proposed
    supplier.
2.2 An employee with an undisclosed relationship to a supplier must not take part in
    selecting that supplier.
3. Supplier Information
3.1 Every purchase request must identify the proposed supplier by its full legal name.
3.2 Supplier names in quotations and invoices must match the supplier named in the
    purchase request.
SYNTHETIC DATA - fictional company and vendors, not a real document
